description: Retrieve recently published MyLatinLife articles and guides, newest first, with URL, dates and excerpt. Optionally match words in the title. This searches MLL content; it is not a news search across the web.

limit.description: How many articles to return. Defaults to 5.

query.description: Words the article title must contain, e.g. "Panama" or "Paraguay residency". Omit for the newest articles overall.

name: get_latest_articles
title: Latest MyLatinLife articles
